# odinex_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up an SSH key by ID, name, fingerprint or label selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the SSH key.
- `id` (Number) ID of the SSH key.
- `name` (String) Name of the SSH key.
- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.

### Read-Only

- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
